name: mcpp-emit-wait
description: Fix plan 2026-09-26 F4 (decision D1): a project whose build system was detected gets clangd with the build tool's model, not the one scanned from its sources that stands in meanwhile. The producer (mcppls-mock-mcpp) hangs past the ten seconds after which scanned sources are planned, and is ended at its 20 s bound: until then mcppls's own engine answers what it can and clangd is given no plan at all, where 0.0.4 gave clangd the provisional plan -- in issue #23 a Windows clangd crashed three times on it before the real model came, and was given up on. After the bound, clangd starts with what there is.
